preconditions.description: The number of test cases t is an integer between 1 and 1000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(n, int) and 1 <= n <= 50 for n in [int(lines[i]) for i in range(1, 2*t+1) if i % 2 == 0])
preconditions.description: For each test case, the matrix size n is an integer between 1 and 50 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(all(c in '01' for c in row) and len(row) == n for case_rows in [lines[i:i+n] for i in range(1, 2*t+1, 2) for n in [int(lines[i-1])] for lines in [stdin_lines] for i in range(1, 2*t+1, 2)] for case_rows in [lines[i:i+n] for i in range(1, 2*t+1, 2) for n in [int(lines[i-1])] for lines in [stdin_lines] for i in range(1, 2*t+1, 2)])
preconditions.description: Each test case consists of n lines, each containing exactly n characters, where every character is either '0' or '1'.

preconditions.expression: sum(n*n for n in [int(lines[i]) for i in range(1, 2*t+1) if i % 2 == 0]) <= 100000
preconditions.description: The total number of cells across all test cases does not exceed 10^5.

postconditions.expression: all(output_lines[i] in ['YES', 'NO', 'yes', 'no', 'Yes', 'No', 'yEs', 'nO'] for i in range(len(output_lines)))
postconditions.description: The output consists of exactly t lines, each being a case-insensitive 'YES' or 'NO'.

postconditions.expression: all((matrix[i][j] == '1' and (matrix[i][j+1] == '1' or matrix[i+1][j] == '1')) or matrix[i][j] == '0' for i in range(n) for j in range(n) for case_idx in range(t) for n in [int(stdin_lines[1 + 2*case_idx])] for matrix in [stdin_lines[1 + 2*case_idx + 1 : 1 + 2*case_idx + 1 + n]])
postconditions.description: For every test case, the output is 'YES' if and only if for every cell (i, j) containing '1', at least one of its right neighbor (i, j+1) or bottom neighbor (i+1, j) also contains '1' (treating out-of-bounds neighbors as '0'). Otherwise, the output is 'NO'.
